integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect your own GitHub, Slack, Google Calendar and Discord accounts. Connections are personal to you, and tokens are stored encrypted. Disconnect any time; you will need to authorise again to reconnect.
integrations.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect {provider}? You will need to re-authorise to use it again.
integrations.not_configured: Not available on this server yet. An administrator needs to set up the OAuth credentials first.

slack.description: Send direct messages and read your DMs as yourself.

ai_activity.description: The latest 50 LLM calls made for this workspace. Prompts are redacted when recorded, so the original text cannot be recovered here.

audit_log.title: Audit log
audit_log.description: A read-only record of who did what in this workspace and when. Sensitive values are redacted when entries are written, and entries cannot be edited here.
audit_log.empty: No audit entries yet. Actions performed in this workspace will appear here as they happen.
audit_log.empty_filtered: No entries match your filters. Clear filters to see all entries.
audit_log.export_csv_hint: Saves only the rows on this page (50 at most) with your current filters. For more, narrow the dates and export page by page.

access_restricted.body: This section is only available to workspace admins.

weekly_digest.title: Weekly digest
weekly_digest.description: A snapshot of this workspace, calculated each time you open it: task counts by state, what was completed in the last seven days, and what is overdue.
weekly_digest.empty_completed: Nothing completed in the last seven days.
weekly_digest.copy_failed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
weekly_digest.countsHint: Number of tasks in each state right now, not only from the last seven days.

general.title: General
general.description: Rename the workspace, change its URL name or description, or delete it.

field.name: Name
field.slug_help: A short unique identifier: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. It must be unique on this server, and you type it to confirm deleting the workspace.

validation.slug_format: URL name may only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
validation.icon_url_format: Icon URL must be a valid URL.

errors.update_failed: Could not update the workspace. Please try again.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Irreversible actions. Deleting a workspace permanently destroys all of its projects, tasks, members, attachments, and uploaded files. This cannot be undone.

confirm.title: Delete {name}?
confirm.warning: This will permanently delete the workspace, all of its projects and tasks, every comment and attachment, and irreversibly remove every uploaded file from object storage.
confirm.loses_projects_and_tasks: All projects, tasks, comments, and timeline history
confirm.loses_members: {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} and their access
confirm.loses_attachments: Every attachment and uploaded file in object storage
confirm.type_to_confirm_label: Type the workspace URL name to confirm
confirm.type_to_confirm_help: Enter {slug} exactly to enable the delete button.

errors.delete_failed: Could not delete the workspace. Please try again.

public_shares.title: Public share pages
public_shares.description: Publish chosen events on a read-only web page. Anyone who has the link can open it without signing in, so only share the link with people who should see these events.
public_shares.empty: No public share pages yet. Create one, then add the events you want to publish.
public_shares.rotate_confirm: Rotate the URL? The current URL will stop working immediately.
public_shares.delete_confirm: Delete "{title}"? The URL will become invalid and events will no longer be published.

errors.create_failed: Could not create the share page. Please try again.
errors.delete_failed: Could not delete the share page. Only workspace admins or owners can delete a share.
errors.rotate_failed: Could not rotate the URL token. Please try again.

field.title: Title
field.description_help: Shown under the title as plain text. Markdown is not rendered.
field.holidays_country_help: Optionally mark this country's public holidays on the page. Leave unset to show none.
field.title_help: Shown as the heading of the public page. Everyone with the link sees it.

dialog.reveal_warning: Copy this URL now. The token is stored hashed — you will not be able to see it again.
dialog.rotate_warning: The previous URL has been invalidated. Share this new URL with anyone who still needs access.

detail.events_description: These events appear on the public page in this order. Visitors see each event's title, time, place and notes. Private events show their time only, and confidential events cannot be added.
detail.empty_events: Nothing is published yet, so the page is empty. Use Add events to pick events from this workspace.

override_notice.label: The public page is showing an out-of-date version of this event
override_notice.moved: This event still shows {from} on the public page. That date has moved to {to}.
override_notice.changed: This event still shows the original version of {at} on the public page. The replacement for that date is not published here.
override_notice.attached: The public page now shows the updated event
override_notice.confidential_moved: This event still shows {from} on the public page. That date has moved to {to}, but the event at the new time is private and cannot be published here. Make it visible, or take this event off the page.
override_notice.confidential_changed: This event still shows the original version of {at} on the public page. The replacement for that date is private and cannot be published here. Make it visible, or take this event off the page.

picker.hint: Showing events within the selected range. Use the checkboxes to pick the events to publish.

mcp_tokens.title: AI tool tokens (MCP)
mcp_tokens.description: Tokens that let an MCP client, such as an AI assistant, work in this workspace as you. Each token is limited to this workspace and to the scopes you pick.
mcp_tokens.empty: No tokens yet. Create one, then give it to your MCP client together with this server's /mcp address.

table.name: Name
table.prefix_help: The first characters of the token, so you can recognise it. The full token cannot be shown again.

mcp_tokens.revoke_confirm: Revoke this token? MCP clients using it will stop working immediately.

field.name: Name
field.name_help: A label to tell tokens apart, such as the machine or client that uses it. Not secret.
field.scopes_help: Every MCP tool call requires at least one scope. A token with none can connect and list tools, but every call is refused.

dialog.reveal_warning: Copy this token now. It is shown only once; if you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.

scope.read_help: List and fetch projects, tasks, pages, and calendars in this workspace.
scope.write_help: Also create, update, and transition them. Includes read.

validation.scopes_rejected: The server refused one of these scopes. Reload the page and try again.

errors.create_failed: Could not create the token. Please try again.

auto_actions.title: Auto-actions
auto_actions.description: Let {appName} check tasks on a schedule and handle clear cases itself. Some actions change tasks without asking (raising the priority of overdue tasks, closing stale reviews); others only record a suggestion.

enabled.label: Enable auto-actions
enabled.description: Allow the system to automatically apply actions to tasks.

interval.label: Evaluation interval
interval.description: How often tasks are checked, in minutes (up to 1440). Set 0 to stop checking.

threshold.label: Confidence threshold
threshold.description: How sure the system must be before it applies an action on its own. Lower means more actions, with more chance of a wrong one; higher is more cautious.

rules.title: Rule configuration
rules.description: Turn individual rules on or off and tune them. Rules only run while auto-actions are enabled above.

column.idle_hours_help: How many hours without activity before the rule counts a task as idle.

escalate_overdue.label: Escalate overdue
escalate_overdue.description: Automatically raises the priority of a task once it passes its due date.

assign_owner.label: Assign owner
assign_owner.description: Records a suggestion to pick an owner when a task has no assignee and has been idle. It does not assign anyone.

nudge_assignee.label: Nudge assignee
nudge_assignee.description: Records a suggestion to nudge the assignee when an assigned task makes no progress. It does not send anything.

close_stale_review.label: Close stale review
close_stale_review.description: Automatically closes a review that has had no activity for the idle time set here.

errors.update_failed: Could not update rule settings. Please try again.
Could not update auto-action settings. Please try again.

export.title: Export tasks
export.description: Download this workspace's tasks as CSV or JSON, up to 10,000 per file. Comments, attachments and other data are not included.
export.truncated: Exported the first {count, number} tasks. This workspace has more than a single export can return, so the file is not a complete backup.

imports.title: Imports

config.label: Configuration JSON
config.hint: For CSV, put the whole CSV text into a field named csv (up to 1 MiB and 5,000 rows). Columns: title, description, priority, dueOn, startedOn. A file exported from this page works as is. Task state cannot be imported.
config.no_credentials: Not a place for credentials: no tokens, API keys, or passwords. This field is not encrypted, and the server refuses them.
config.credentials_where: Connect the service in integration settings instead

create.source_help: Only CSV can be imported today. GitHub, Jira and Linear are coming soon.

imports.empty_hint: Import tasks from a CSV with New import job. Progress and any errors appear here.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Send an HTTP POST to your own server when selected events happen in this workspace. Each request is signed so you can verify it came from here.

col.active_help: Turn off to pause deliveries. Events that happen while it is off are not sent later.

confirm.title: Delete this webhook?
confirm.message: Future deliveries will stop immediately and the secret will be unrecoverable.

url.hint: Must be a public HTTPS address. Local and private-network addresses are refused. The URL cannot be edited later.
url.label: Delivery URL

event_types.label: Event types
event_types.hint: Exact event names separated by commas, such as task.created, task.transition.complete. Enter * for every event. Patterns like task.* are not supported.
event_types.required: Enter * for every event, or at least one event name.
event_types.no_patterns: Patterns such as task.* are not supported. Use exact event names, or * on its own.

secret.label: Signing secret
secret.warning: Copy this now or come back via Show secret to retrieve it again.
secret.hint: Each request carries X-Nodate-Signature (v0= plus HMAC-SHA256 of v0:timestamp:body, keyed with this secret) and X-Nodate-Timestamp. Verify both on your server and keep the secret private.

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.status_note: Failed deliveries are retried automatically with growing delays. Gave up means the retries ran out, or the webhook was turned off or deleted before delivery.

webhooks.empty_hint: Create a webhook to have this workspace call your server when events happen. You can then use Send test to check it.

secret_callout.once_title: Copy it now. It is shown only once.
